laws_and_bills.name: HB 2992 Data Center Customer Ratepayer Protection Act of 2026
laws_and_bills.what: Requires large data centers to pay for their own energy infrastructure so costs are not passed to residential ratepayers. Passed House 84-0, Senate 48-0; emergency clause.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 259 Groundwater Modernization Act
laws_and_bills.what: Bars data centers from groundwater use for open-air evaporative cooling without recirculation; requires low-consumptive cooling (closed-loop, immersion) for a permit; annual water-use reports to OWRB. Effective Nov. 1, 2026.
